INSERT INTO [APP_CAEDM].[DW_ETL_AUDIT] (
    ETL_DATE,
    ETL_TIME,
    ENTITY,
    START_DTM,
    END_DTM,
    STATUS
    )
  VALUES (
    CONVERT(varchar(10),GETDATE(),112)+0,
    REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(10),GETDATE(),108),':',''),
    'DW FACT MEMBER CONCEPT',
    GETDATE(),
    NULL,
    'I'
    )

scripts.text:
UPDATE FMC SET
FMC.TERM_DATE=STG.TERM_DATE,FMC.TERM_TIME=STG.TERM_TIME
FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_CONCEPT FMC  WITH (ROWLOCK)
	JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_FACT_MEMBER_TERM_DATE_STG STG WITH(NOLOCK)
	ON FMC.MEME_CK=STG.MEME_CK AND FMC.GROUP_CK=STG.GROUP_CK AND FMC.CONCEPT_KEY=STG.CONCEPT_KEY
	AND FMC.EFF_DATE=STG.EFF_DATE AND FMC.EFF_TIME=STG.EFF_TIME
WHERE FMC.TERM_DATE=20991231

UPDATE APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_AUDIT
    SET STATUS='C',
	   END_DTM=GETDATE()
    WHERE
	  (STATUS='I' or STATUS='E')
	   AND
	   ID = (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_AUDIT WHERE ENTITY='DW FACT MEMBER CONCEPT')

UPDATE APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_AUDIT
SET STATUS='E',
	END_DTM=GETDATE()
 WHERE
	STATUS='I'
	AND
	ID = (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM 	APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_AUDIT WHERE 	ENTITY='DW FACT MEMBER CONCEPT')
	AND
	END_DTM IS NULL
